name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.39-beta “Paris” (build 44): menus and ribbon exactly as on the Mac.
• The menu bar and the ribbon now come from the Mac's own description: the same menus, groups, order and ribbon buttons, with the Windows wording in English, German and French.
• Ribbon colours as on the Mac (the Exhibit group is blue), and Usage is now its own ribbon tab.
• The search box sits in the title-bar row beside the menus.
• Windows shortcuts: F2 renames, Ctrl+H finds and replaces in titles, Alt+Shift+Up/Down moves an exhibit, F5 syncs, Alt+Enter edits the exhibit, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N makes a new matter. AltGr keeps typing @ € { } [ ].
